title: chionanthus polygamus
intro: Chionanthus polygamus, commonly known as the white fringe tree, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to the southeastern United States. The health benefits of Chionanthus polygamus include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and act as an antispasmodic, helping to relieve muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of Chionanthus polygamus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
